use_case: B1 synthetic FX dealing — architect's answer key

mappings.rationale: Client quoting is Currency Exchange's Quote partition; the capability is that responsibility.
Capturing the client FX transaction is Currency Exchange's FX Transaction Capture partition.
Booking interbank trades and keeping the deal blotter is Trader Position Operations' scope.
Desk-wide consolidated position tracking and desk limits sit with Dealer Desk.
Per-trader trading permissions and limits sit with Trader Position Operations.
Confirmation, affirmation and break escalation are Trade Confirmation Matching's whole scope.
Cash settlement of both legs and settlement confirmation are Trade Settlement's scope.
The counterparty directory and permitted transactions are Counterparty Administration.
Taking in contributor feeds and distributing them internally is Market Data Switch Operation.
Activities 01b and 01c quote and capture the client FX transaction.
Activity 01a checks the counterparty's permitted transactions.
Activity 01d puts the deal on the trader's deal blotter (not yet recorded in invokes).
Activity 02a reads the desk's consolidated position.
Activities 02b and 02c read dealer limits and capture the interbank cover trade.
All three activities are confirmation, matching and escalation operations.
Activities 04b and 04c initiate, execute and confirm the cash settlement.
Activity 04a reads the counterparty's standing settlement instructions from counterparty reference data.
Aurora implements the Quote partition: it issues and serves client quotes.
Ledgerline implements FX Transaction Capture: it books, reads and amends client deals.
Ledgerline keeps the blotter, books interbank trades and holds dealer limits.
Ledgerline computes the desk's consolidated net open position.
ConfirmHub issues, matches and escalates confirmations.
Settlement Manager creates, releases and confirms cash settlement.
CRDS is the counterparty directory with permitted products.
The Rates Gateway takes in contributor feeds and distributes them to subscribers.
Creating a firm quote is Initiate on the Quote partition.
Reading one quote is Retrieve on the Quote partition.
Booking a client deal creates an FX transaction capture.
Reading a booked deal is Retrieve on FX Transaction Capture.
Amending a booked deal is Update on FX Transaction Capture.
Recording an interbank trade is Initiate on Trade Capture and Reporting.
Reading the trader blotter is Retrieve on Trade Deal Blotter.
The desk net open position is Retrieve on Consolidated Position Tracking.
Dealer limit headroom is Retrieve on Trader Trading Permissions and Limits.
Issuing our confirmation is Initiate on Transaction Confirmation Affirmation.
Running the automated match is Execute on Transaction Confirmation Affirmation.
Reading a confirmation is Retrieve on Transaction Confirmation Affirmation.
Reading a break case is Retrieve on Unmatched Market Trade Escalation.
Raising an escalation is Initiate on Unmatched Market Trade Escalation.
Creating the pay-leg instruction is Initiate on Market Trade Cash Settlement.
Releasing the payment is Execute on Market Trade Cash Settlement.
Reading an instruction is Retrieve on Market Trade Cash Settlement.
Recording the nostro advice creates the settlement confirmation of the receive leg.
Reading a counterparty is Retrieve on the Counterparty Directory Entry.
Onboarding a counterparty is Register on the Counterparty Directory Entry.
Permitted products are Retrieve on Counterparty Permitted Transaction.
Setting up a feed to a consumer is Initiate on Distribution.
